Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00323725
Sheriff’s File # 26001903
PLAINTIFF – Bil-Man Asset Management LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- 1039 Norwood Holdings, LLC; et al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 9th day of November, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Long Branch, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 7, Block 5, Tax Map of City of Long Branch
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1039 Norwood Avenue Long Branch, NJ 07740
Dimensions of the Premises: Approximately a half of an acre.
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately between Lafayette Place and Cambridge Avenue
Upset Price: $2,128,271.91
Occupancy Status: Vacant
Legal Description for 1039 Norwood:
All that certain lot, tract or parcel of land, situate lying and being in the municipality of City of Long Branch, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey:
BEGINNING at a point in the easterly line of Norwood Avenue said point being distant 260.50 feet northerly from the intersection formed by the easterly line of Norwood Avenue and the northerly line of South Lincoln Avenue, said point also being the dividing line between Lots 6 and 7, Block 5 on the tax map and from thence:
(1) South 87 degrees 14 minutes 00 seconds East, 150.33 feet to a point, thence
(2) North 02 degrees 46 minutes 00 seconds East, 10.33 feet to a point, thence
(3) South 77 degrees 20 minutes 00 seconds East 28.40 feet to a point, thence
(4) North 18 degrees 39 minutes 10 seconds East 75.74 feet to a point in the southerly line of 16.0 foot right of way: thence
(5) North 72 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds West along the southerly line of same, 215.40 feet to a point in the easterly line of Norwood Avenue: thence
(6) South 00 degrees 58 minutes 00 seconds East along the easterly line of same, 135.18 feet to a pipe found at the aforesaid dividing line between Lots 6 and 7, Block 5 and the place of BEGINNING
The above description being in accordance with a survey prepared by ELs Surveying, LLC dated September 9, 2022.
FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY: BEING commonly as 1039 Norwood Avenue, Tax Lot 7 in Tax Block 5 on the Official Tax Map of the City of Long Branch, NJ.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $2,129,170.92.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: September 16, 2026
Hasbani & Light, P.C.
450 Seventh Avenue
Suite 1901
New York, NY 10123
